note: Omits the clause 'until they were utterly destroyed' (עַד תֻּמָּם).
Second clause changes subject: 'Yahweh descended' rendered as 'the people of the Lord descended.'
Razor is mistranslated as 'Moses' (موسى), adding Moses and omitting the razor.
Statement 'I will die of thirst' turned into a rhetorical question ('shall I die...?').
'were called together/summoned' rendered as 'the men cried out' (active shouting), changing the sense.
Adds 'the two previous times'; source says only 'as at other times/as before'.
'Razor' (מוֹרָה) is mistranslated as 'Moses' (موسى), so the razor not touching his head is lost.
Coulter (אֵת) omitted; 'ax' is repeated twice instead of listing four distinct tools.
'Of Solomon's reign' attached to 'second month' instead of 'fourth year'; fourth year of reign not stated
Omits 'with them/it' (אִתּוֹ) — incense burned together with the offerings is dropped.
Arabic says 'the prophet of the young man' instead of 'the young man the prophet,' adding a genitive relation and changing the title.
Adds 'son of Yamin' (ابن يمين) after 'of Benjamin,' not in the source.
Omits 'for the foundation' (לְיִסּוֹד); Arabic only says they began placing the heaps.
Says 'cities of Samaria' plural instead of the singular 'city of Samaria'.
Adds 'translated' (مترجمة), which is not in the source's 'plainly read'.
Adds that the fields and vineyards are pledged; the source only names them.
Adds cutting a tall tree and making wood from it, not in source's 'make a gallows'.
Hebrew 'upon men' (plural) rendered as 'upon a man' (singular), changing the referent.
Reverses roles: 'words reprove' instead of 'you reprove words' (words made subject, not object)
"you work wonders against me" rendered as "you are amazed at me"; also "it grows proud" changed to "if I rise"
Rhetorical question "will he not consider?" turned into a negative statement "he does not consider it"
'Moving of my lips will restrain' changed to 'consolation of my lips will lighten from you'—adds consolation/lighten, omits moving/restrain.
Adds 'floods' as agent not in source; source says his increase shall be carried/flow away.
Renders 'breasts full of milk' as 'basins full of fat'; changes distinct image/idea.
Calls the Almighty 'your gold' instead of 'your defense'; adds gold and omits defense.
Renders 'become vanity' as 'speak vanity'; adds speaking and omits becoming vain.
Arabic reverses subject: 'I reared him' instead of 'he was brought up with me'.
'answers with men of iniquity' rendered 'his turning as a man of iniquity' — changes meaning and number
Replaces 'Will he esteem your cry? No, not gold' with 'Will your wealth save you from distress' — different subject and predicate.
Source is a statement 'You know'; Arabic turns it into a question 'Do you know?'
Adds 'around us' (حولنا); source says simply 'around' without an object.
Omits 'in our steps' (בְּאַשֻּׁרֵינוּ); also renders 'bow down to the earth' as 'cast us down to the earth'.
Hebrew 'those who conceal/hide' rendered as 'those who show off/pretend' — opposite idea.
Adds 'again and again' (مَرَّةً بَعْدَ مَرَّةٍ), an idea not in the source.
Adds 'bread' (خبزًا) as the object of seeking, which is not in the source.
Adds 'the word of' before salvation; source has 'your salvation according to your word'.
First clause changes subject: source 'He will not let your foot be moved' becomes imperative 'Do not let your foot slip'.
Source 'all your tin' is rendered 'all your impurity', losing the specific metal term.
'your strength' rendered as 'her mighty ones'; person shifted from 2nd to 3rd
Comparison subjects reversed: Carchemish/Calno, Arpad/Hamath, Damascus/Samaria swapped from source order.
'Pour out a molten image' replaced by 'weave a covenant/league', adding an idea not in the source and dropping the molten image.
'men of Israel' rendered as 'remnant of Israel', adding an idea not in the source
Titles 'God of hosts, God of Israel' rendered as 'جند الله إسرائيل', omitting 'God' (إله) in both titles.
Negation reversed: source says 'do not let the archer bend his bow / not lift himself up,' Arabic says 'let him bend... let him rise.'
Adds 'no helper for them' (لا معين لهم), not in the source.
Source 'they profaned me' (3rd person) rendered as 'you profaned me' (2nd person).
Adds 'in the fire' (في النار), which is not in the source.
'one eagle' (אחד) rendered as 'another eagle' (آخر), changing the meaning.
Replaces 'in their pit he was caught' with an added clause 'an ambush was set for him'; 'pit' omitted.
Renders 'to spend my anger' as 'to complete my face,' losing the anger idea.
Arabic says 'five cubits' instead of 'five hundred reeds' as in the source/English.
Adds 'on the roof' (على سطح); source says in the royal palace.
Adds 'days' (أيام) to 'your kingdom'; source has only 'your kingdom.'
Changes subject: 'when he became strong' rendered 'when his great horn became strong'; also adds 'horns.'
Omits 'I was weakened'; renders only 'I became sick and remained sick.'
Source is a statement ('you brought me'), Arabic turns it into a question ('هل قدمتم').
'Their best' is rendered as 'their companions'; 'worse than a thorn hedge' is weakened to 'like a hedge'.
Adds 'who is the head of the temple' (وهو رئيس الهيكل), not in the source.
'defrauded by you' becomes 'withheld from them', losing that the employers are the defrauders
Adds 'in this world', which is not in the source
Subject changed: Hebrew says the priest himself eats, Arabic says the acquired person eats
Number rendered as 1259 (adds 'fifty') instead of 1254.
First clause changed from 'I would comfort myself' (action) to an exclamation 'O my comfort'
Final clause 'they had made it the prison' rendered as 'they put him in the prison house', losing the idea that the house was made the prison.
Hebrew 'his anger' (אַפּוֹ) rendered as 'his face', losing the idea that he does not retain anger.
'the rest of the nations' (יֶתֶר גּוֹי) rendered 'the rest of my people', adding 'my' and changing nations to people.
Arabic says 'the Lord cursed' instead of 'has indignation against,' adding curse and omitting indignation.
Adds an extra vessel (الكفوف) to the list of four gold items in the source.
